sheets.prompt: Character design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one prowler, a lean reptilian monster, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, three-quarter view caught mid back-flip, and its attack wind-up crouched low on bent legs with a short curved blade drawn back, its tail lashing. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade backpack stands beside it for scale; the prowler is 1.8 metres tall standing, often crouched. Design: human proportions and joints, a long narrow lizard head with a crest of short spines, wide-set yellow eyes, a long tail, long digitigrade legs, three clawed fingers; smooth leaf-green scaly skin with a cream throat, the base colour of its kind; a single shoulder guard; a short curved blade. Quick and sly. Original design, medium detail, a strong readable silhouette. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream paper grain, evenly spaced views, fully visible bodies, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, lettering, labels, scenery, hollow knight, white mask, drapes, bandages, mummy, robes, gore.
